requiredBehaviors.behavior: apply the current pathway-specific acceptance mechanism rather than one generic checklist
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow separately resolves current 510(k) RTA/acceptance policy and De Novo eSTAR/technical-screening logic.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: separate administrative or technical acceptance readiness from substantive scientific adequacy
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Acceptance and substantive review are explicitly separate, and substantive concerns are classified independently from technical completeness.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: apply 510(k) RTA logic unchanged to a De Novo submission

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: equate an internal ready result with FDA acceptance clearance or grant
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: ready-for-human-submission is explicitly internal-only and not FDA accepted, cleared or granted.
